items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1963-03-28
items.q: I had Buddy message bandit the same as Chris did.

ctx.x: He made a good reputation over there. After he... I had Buddy message bandit the same as Chris did. Chris had a line of work around him, man. He was working, exactly, every night. Five nights every week, sometimes, every night. They take them double dates. Mm-hmm. All right, now.
